expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The agent quotes: "Every attempt to capture one pantry order sends the same idempotency key, the one its first attempt used" and "in 2024 retries that drew a fresh key for each attempt charged 41 members twice." It also states it has not changed anything because doing so would bring back the double-charge bug.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
